notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (curl) checked first - generic Allow, only disallows /search,/cart,/account,/checkout etc, no Claude/anthropic-ai block; tier (a) direct HTTP (curl + grep/bs4-style parsing) used for robots.txt, sitemap_index.xml, sitemap_8-category.xml (840 URLs) and homepage nav HTML to build the full category-link union, and for confirming canonical redirects and product-tile composition (SSR HTML at worldmarket.com does include real <a href=/p/...> product links per category page, cross-checked against rendered counts e.g. Baskets: 50 unique /p/ links == rendered '50 Items'). TREE: union of homepage mega-menu hrefs (regex over full HTML) + sitemap_8-category.xml + each category page's own left-nav 'Refine by Category' sub-list (Playwright), confirming h1/canonical on every leaf recorded. QTY: category page header 'Items' count only appears after JS hydration (not in raw HTML text), so tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium, load+5s settle) was used to read the rendered 'NNN Items' / 'Showing X-Y of NNN' text and h1/canonical for every leaf and candidate node - this is the SFCC storefront's own displayed total, never estimated. EXCLUDED: Sale/Clearance/Free-Shipping/New-and-Trending/Best-Sellers/Holidays(Christmas/Halloween/Fall) subtrees (cross-cutting promo/seasonal collections per rule 27/35); View-All/Shop-All links; Rifle Paper Co. x Loloi Rugs and Pillows (brand collab cross-listing, overlapping products already counted under Area/Accent Rugs and Throw Pillows); /c/bath/bath-robes/ (redirects 301 to /c/clothing-and-jewelry/women-s-clothing/women-s-pajamas-and-robes/ - genuine apparel category, not a bath-textile leaf); /c/bath/bathroom-accessories/ (34 items, sampled product slugs = soap dispensers/canisters/vanity trays/soap dishes - decorative bath accessories, neither textile nor storage function); /c/kitchen/kitchen-storage-and-organization/reusable-totes-and-lunch-bags/ (5 items, sampled = canvas tote bags / insulated lunch bags - personal-carrying bags, explicitly excluded by storage.md #6); /c/decor-and-pillows/home-office/ (88 items, sampled = stationery/pens/journals/picture frames/novelty gifts with only incidental storage-adjacent SKUs - not primarily a storage category, no dedicated organizer sub-URL exists); all Furniture-nav storage items (/c/furniture/storage-furniture/*, dressers-and-storage, living-room storage-cabinets-and-shelving, small-spaces-organization) excluded from Storage per storage.md #21/#27 (explicitly placed under Furniture nav - belongs to the already-validated Furniture.xlsx, not duplicated here); rug/accent-rug size-variant pages (e.g. 4'x6', 9'x12', 2'x3') treated as size facets of their parent (Area Rugs/Accent Rugs), not distinct taxonomy nodes, so only the parent leaf (with the site's own total) was recorded; duplicate URL aliases deduped via canonical (rugs/bath-mats-and-rugs -> bath/bathroom-rugs-and-mats; outdoor/outdoor-rugs and outdoor/outdoor-decor/outdoor-pillows-and-cushions/... -> outdoor/outdoor-decor/... canonical; decor-and-pillows/pillows-and-throws/outdoor-cushions-and-pillows/ -> redirects to the outdoor-pillows-and-cushions parent group, already represented by its own children; furniture/storage-furniture/bathroom-storage-and-furniture/ -> redirects to bath/bathroom-storage-and-furniture/, already represented; bath/bathroom-storage-and-furniture/bathroom-baskets/ -> redirects to decor-and-pillows/baskets/, recorded once as 'Baskets'). LOW-confidence flags: 'Baskets' (Storage, 50 items) is a mixed bucket of genuine woven storage/utility/tote/laundry-hamper baskets and a minority of novelty shaped decorative baskets - kept as Storage (dominant product terms are utility/tote/storage) but marked MEDIUM. 'Wall Storage' (10 items) name explicitly says Storage but sampled products are decorative floating wall shelves/shelf brackets (Wall Decor boundary per storage.md #18) - kept as Storage per the site's own category name but marked LOW and queued for review. 'Napkins & Napkin Rings' (82 items) and 'Shower Curtains & Rings' (7 items) mix textile product with a minority hardware/ring accessory on the same listing page with no separate URL to split them - kept as Textile (majority product type) at MEDIUM/HIGH confidence respectively (napkins sample: 44 napkin vs 7 ring SKUs on page 1).
